text:
incident-bot: SEV2 Pager -> GPU pool exhaustion and autoscaler failures on gpu-pool-prod-west-1. Queue growth observed, autoscaler hitting pool limit and failing to place pods. Triggered 2026-03-14T21:04:31Z (ts 3932101111). Affected customers: live-chat-app, docs-gen.

alex: seeing ~4.8k queued requests across the fronting queue, error spike at 21:03. Autoscaler logs: `scale_event: rejected - pool_limit_reached` repeated.

alex: small excerpt from autoscaler (tail):
```
2026-03-14T21:02:58Z autoscaler.ERROR scale_event rejected pool_limit_reached pool=gpu-pool-prod-west-1 requested=40 available=0 limit=80
2026-03-14T21:03:10Z autoscaler.WARN allocation_fail reason=fragmentation details="candidate nodes insufficient contiguous MIG resources"
2026-03-14T21:03:40Z queue.INFO inflight=120 pending=4800
```

devon: taking pager. oncall handoff from alex -> devon. I'm checking MIG sizing and packing ratios.

maria: quick glance at node inventory: many hosts are sliced into small MIGs (3g) while several workloads request larger contiguous slices (7g). Binpacking is failing: we have lots of free vram scattered.

kai: looks like the autoscaler counts nodes as available but placement fails because scheduler requires contiguous MIG allocations for the model kernel. fragmentation++

devon: running `infractl pool describe gpu-pool-prod-west-1` to confirm topology.
```
infractl pool describe gpu-pool-prod-west-1 --json | jq '.nodes | {total: length, mig_profiles: map(.mig_profile) | unique}'
```

devon: result: total=96 nodes, mig_profiles=["1g","3g","7g"], majority are 3g and 1g slices. Only ~12 nodes have 7g contiguous slices.

anya: docs-gen model needs 7g allocation to run non-quantized. live-chat-app has a fallback to 3g-quant but it's currently disabled.

support-jordan: customer-impact update: live-chat-app experiencing elevated latencies (p95 up 3x) and intermittent errors. Support alerted top customers, they're seeing queue timeouts ~10-15s.

sre-pager: Can we temporarily enable quantized fallback for live-chat-app and docs-gen while we rebalance? Might reduce quality but stop customer errors.

devon: plan: 1) temporarily increase pool soft-limit to allow burst (if infra quota permits) 2) trigger emergency rebalance/pack to reduce fragmentation 3) enable model fallback for critical customers 4) monitor metrics and rollback if regressions.

kai: I can bump the pool limit from 80 -> 120 for 30 minutes. Doing now: `console: update pool quota gpu-pool-prod-west-1 --limit 120 --reason "emergency autoscale burst"`

kai: pool limit increased, API responded 200.

devon: starting rebalance job: `infractl rebalance --pool gpu-pool-prod-west-1 --strategy pack --drain-timeout 300s --concurrency 6` . This will try to consolidate workloads into larger contiguous MIG hosts.

maria: rebalance logs: started scheduling drains on 18 low-util nodes, reassigning pods. Expect ~6-8 minutes to get first wave of capacity.

alex: enabling quantized fallback for live-chat-app via feature-flag: `ff toggle live-chat-app.model_fallback_quantized on --ttl 60m` (will notify product).

support-jordan: notifying customers: sent short advisory to top 3 customers affected. Mentioned we are doing an emergency capacity rebalance and may enable temporary model fallback.

devon: first wave done. observed immediate drop in pending queue from 4800 -> 1200 in ~7m. Autoscaler started placing new pods again but still seeing occasional placement failures referencing MIG fragmentation.

maria: observed leftover stranded capacities: ~4 nodes with high free VRAM but in 1g slices making them unusable for 7g workload. We'll need longer-term reimage or MIG profile change if this recurs.

kai: pool quota still 120, but autoscaler reports `allocation_succeeded` for recent CRs.

devon: manually scaled down a few non-critical batch jobs to free large-slice nodes: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 job/batch-embed-ttl` -> freed two 7g hosts.

anya: re-enabled docs-gen non-quantized rollout for a subset (canary) once we confirmed placement.

support-jordan: customer impact update (21:20): live-chat-app p95 latency back within SLA for 2/3 customers, third sees intermittent spikes but no timeouts. docs-gen errors reduced to 1.2% from 8%.

sre-pager: Are we comfortable marking as mitigated? Need postmortem owner and follow-ups: revisit autoscaler placement logic + add proactive defragmenter.

devon: marking mitigated for now. Postmortem owner: devon. Action items: A) autoscaler should consider packing score, not just raw free VRAM; B) add proactive MIG repack during low-traffic windows; C) expose fragmentation metrics to console; D) longer-term: recommend model teams to enable fallback quantized models or smaller-slice builds.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Queue drain ongoing, autoscaler healthy. Will monitor for 60m cooldown. Severity downgraded to SEV3. Postmortem assigned to devon.

alex: thumbs up. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

devon: leaving final notes: total time to effective mitigation ~18m from page. Root cause summary: high request spike + heterogeneous MIG sizing causing binpacking failures and autoscaler hitting pool soft limit; resulted in stranded capacity on small-slice hosts.

sre-pager: filing postmortem doc and linking follow-ups.

support-jordan: will follow up with customers with a brief incident summary and expected remediation timeline for eradication of fragmentation.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now. If queue grows again, re-open and escalate to SEV2.
